name: Revenge On My Cheating Fiancé
overview: Lyla's path to vengeance begins with her working as a waitress in a prestigious restaurant, a far cry from the life she once knew. With each passing day, Lyla's transformation is remarkable. She evolves from a broken-hearted waitress into a formidable and cunning businesswoman, fueled by a quest for revenge, works her way to the top. Does she get her desired revenge?...
